data.one_liner: Animates between two icons with customizable colors, size, and tooltips.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that smoothly transitions between a start and an end icon. A controller can trigger the animation programmatically or via press callbacks.
use_when: You need a simple toggle animation between two icons (e.g., add/close).
You want built‑in support for start/end tooltips and separate colors.
avoid_when: You require complex vector or timeline animations (Lottie, Rive).
You need animation curves beyond the default or multi‑step sequences.
strengths: Very small API focused on icon transitions.
Supports both press‑based and controller‑driven animation.
Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms.
weaknesses: No built‑in custom curves or advanced animation sequencing.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose animation library that can also animate icons with more control.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: For complex, vector‑based animations beyond simple icon swaps.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides quick declarative animations, including simple icon fades.
